liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Heaven Help The Fool** (1 review): Reviewer calls this version stellar [8]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Acoustic treatment of this song is described as redefining it [14]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Third set opens with this song, pushed straight into Scarlet Begonias without missing a beat [15]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The Scarlet into Fire pairing is described as ripping, as it usually does [10]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Reviewer rates it the best Minglewood they had heard [8]

## The recordings

- **gd80-10-27.senn441.lai.324.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 29 songs; 199 min; rated 4.64/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording is bright and up front, with a well-balanced level of crowd noise; Acoustic set is crisp and clear on this recording, with high-energy playing; Sennheiser 441 mics capture the room sound well, with wide frequency range and little hiss [8][10][11][14]
- **gd1980-10-27.senn441.wise.miller.101293.flac16**: source not stated; 29 songs; 205 min; rated 3/5 by 7 [5]. Said about its sound: Recording and transfer are spectacular, with the acoustic set sounding especially good for an audience tape [17]
- **gd80-10-27.sonyecm270.larson.7290.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 29 songs; 203 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1980-10-27.nak300.morrone.friend.116196.flac1644**: audience recording; 29 songs; 199 min [3]

## Around the show

- Suits watched in amazement as thousands of fans spilled out onto 6th Avenue outside Radio City [6]
- Reviewer bought windowpane acid outside before the show, then heard a sitar player at an Indian restaurant [9]
- Fans sprawled across the huge spiral staircase between sets [9]
- Management had previously hosted nothing wilder than the Rockettes, then got 3000+ acid-fueled fans [9]
- Taper recorded from the center of the lower balcony, several rows back [1]
- The reviewer ranks this October 1980 Radio City run among the most defining stretches for them personally [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd80-10-27.senn441.lai.324.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser 441 [1]
- **gd1980-10-27.senn441.wise.miller.101293.flac16**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sennheiser 441 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B) [5]. Also: The transfer is credited to Mr. Wise [17]
- **gd80-10-27.sonyecm270.larson.7290.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-280/D-5 [2]
- **gd1980-10-27.nak300.morrone.friend.116196.flac1644**: taped by Tim Friend;Joe Morrone; transferred by AndrewF; source: flac16: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300/CP1 cardioids > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell UDXLII. Set up in second mezzanine front row, mics hand-held by Tim Friend, recording by… [3]
